basic_info.description: Beautifully remodeled duplex featuring 2,424 square feet of living space on a 2495 square feet lot in San Francisco's hip and vibrant Outer Sunset. This move-in ready gem offers an exceptional opportunity for owner occupants, investors, or multigenerational living with two spacious 2 bedroom flats, both delivered vacant and thoughtfully upgraded. Each unit boasts modern kitchens with new sinks, faucets, quartz countertops and backsplashes. Updated bathrooms include new vanities, LED lighting, medicine cabinets and toilets. Fresh interior paint, new door locks and elegant LED lighting enhance every room with style. The living rooms feature cozy wood burning fireplaces and double pane windows that welcome natural light. The top unit showcases refinished hardwood floors while the lower unit offers new luxury vinyl flooring for a sleek, modern feel. The exterior is freshly painted with a beach inspired vibe, and the property includes a 2 car garage with ADU and development potential. Just steps from Ocean Beach, Golden Gate Park, top rated schools and the shops and dining along Judah Street, this duplex perfectly blends coastal charm with urban convenience. A rare turnkey opportunity in one of San Francisco's most desirable neighborhoods!
